ideas.title: The Free Coin Trap
ideas.logline: Max finds a free-coin button, holds it down, and gets buried until Mia pays one coin to stop it.

ideas.title: The AFK Champion
ideas.logline: Leo is AFK for five rounds of a disaster-survival game and keeps surviving by accident until Max and Mia try to get him kicked.

ideas.title: Admin For One Round
ideas.logline: Leo gets admin commands for one round, spams a useless 'explode' command, and finds out too late that it was aimed at himself.

ideas.title: The AFK Millionaire
ideas.logline: Last one in the circle wins a million coins: Leo, Max and Mia take each other out with tricks while the noob never moves, because he was eating dinner.
